changeSet.sql:
UPDATE reg_registration_submission SET nation_id = CASE nation WHEN 'England' THEN 1 WHEN 'Scotland' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wales' THEN 3 WHEN 'NorthernIreland' THEN 4 END;
-- Dropping the old column also drops its CHECK constraint. ALTER TABLE reg_registration_submission ALTER COLUMN nation_id SET NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_reg_registration_submission_nation_id CHECK (nation_id BETWEEN 1 AND 4), DROP COLUMN nation;
